name: Barrage Stance
description: Gain 30% attack speed and 2 extra projectiles. Kunai inflict poison: each stack deals 5% of its hit damage over 5 seconds. Hits refresh all stacks, up to 20. Choose one Ninja stance per run.

name: Needle Rain
description: Every fourth attack fires twice as many kunai.

name: Forked Blades
description: Kunai have a 15% chance to split on impact into 2 blades dealing 50% damage each. Split blades apply poison but cannot split again.

name: Toxic Ground
description: Killing an enemy poisoned by your kunai leaves a puddle for 3 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds it applies 1 poison stack, matching the victim's average stack strength. Puddle poison alone cannot create another puddle.

name: Samurai Assist
description: Each attack has a 5% chance to call a Samurai assist. An active assist cannot overlap itself.

name: Critical Strike
description: Kunai hits have a 15% chance to deal double damage. Poison inherits the increased hit damage.

name: Viper's Rush
description: Killing a poisoned enemy grants 20% movement speed for 3 seconds. Further kills refresh the duration.

name: Kunai Damage
description: Kunai deal 20% more damage.

name: Attack Speed
description: Attack 15% faster.

name: Kunai Reach
description: Kunai travel 15% farther.

name: Lingering Venom
description: Poison lasts 2 seconds longer, dealing damage at the same rate.

name: Venom Load
description: Each kunai hit applies 2 additional poison stacks.

name: Relentless Rain
description: Needle Rain requires 1 fewer attack. At maximum rank, every attack fires twice as many kunai.

name: Branching Blades
description: Kunai gain 10% split chance. With Serpent's Procession, each ricochet instead loses 2% less damage.

name: Reinforcements
description: Gain 5% chance to call a Samurai assist.

name: Spreading Blight
description: Poison puddles have 20% more radius.

name: Critical Precision
description: Kunai gain 10% critical strike chance.

name: Deep Venom
description: Enemies can hold 4 additional poison stacks.

name: Point-Blank Barrage
description: Gain 50% attack speed, but kunai travel 70% less distance.

name: Serpent's Procession
description: Fire kunai in a straight sequence. They ricochet to 3 additional enemies, losing 25% damage per bounce, and cannot split. Split upgrades become ricochet upgrades that reduce damage lost per bounce.

name: Venom Bloom
description: Puddles no longer apply poison. Every 0.5 seconds they instead deal 10% of each enemy's remaining poison damage without consuming its stacks.
